questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy clearly outlines climate action as its core purpose. The policy also outlines the need to identify and prioritise actions that are consistent with the goals of the Climate Emergency Declaration and with the Council's current planning framework. These actions are particularly emphasised if they are likely to have the greatest positive effect, especially in relation to current base level emissions and cost-effectiveness.
